body: From the DM-175 review (orchestrator, this run): fix and pin — (1) withdrawing the base report of a duplicate-joined defect group falls back to the earliest report rather than a live one sharing its judgement, dropping a still-valid charge (src/core/space/defects.ts `defectOf`); (2) a late `reconcileAttempt` resubmit changes the attempt state read at an older cutoff between the lease deadline and the resubmit (verification.ts `stateAt`; verdict unchanged). Pin the defect judgement-group cases (3-report, alternating, duplicate citing a later report) and the same-cutoff reproducibility repros in %TEMP%/dm175-review/adv*.ts.
